messages:
cheng: Nightly alert: safety-suite fail rate up ~5x for redwood-v2-int8-optimized on cohort 'policy-asserts'. Failing tests include policy-flagging (false positives) and assert_count spike.
maya: Oof. Severity?
cheng: P2 — user-visible false positives rising, some blocks in integration tests. Need triage.
liam: Can we diff fp16 vs int8 outputs for the same prompts first? might indicate quantization shift.
sara: Agreed. Also want raw model logits / temperatures. If it's calibration, we can quick-pin quant recipe.
ci-bot: nightly-evals/results/2345678901 -> https://ci.redwood/evals/2345678901 (contains cohort breakdown + sample ids)
alex: I'll run a quick sample diff. Assigning: alex -> sample diff, maya -> curation of failing prompts, liam -> quant-recipe review, sara -> rollback plan.
maya: I'll pull 50 failing prompts now and tag false-positive type.
maya: sample ids: 9834, 9835, 9870, 9921 ...
liam: quick diff snippet:
```
python eval/diff_outputs.py --model fp16/redwood-v2 --model int8/redwood-v2-int8-optimized --ids 9834,9835,9870
```
liam: sample output (id 9834):
```
FP16: "This content violates policy X? no."
INT8: "This content violates policy X and should be flagged."
```
liam: Several cases show higher assertion strength in INT8.
cheng: Note: quant-recipe v3 was rolled in at 02:15 UTC in last deploy — check changelog.
sara: If it's recipe related, we should pin to v2 and run a canary rollback. Ops ok with that?
ops-bot: deploy/canary-rollback scheduled by @alex -> redwood-v2-int8-optimized -> rollback to v2-recipe at 2026-03-20T04:10Z
alex: Starting rollback now, will post confirmation when canary completes.
ci-bot: canary results (prelim): false-positive rate on policy-asserts dropped from 5.1% to 1.2% after rollback.
maya: Good sign. Need follow-up: run full nightly again after rollback and create an eval ticket for quant-recipe regression.
liam: I'll add a unit test that asserts parity between fp16 and int8 for this cohort (tolerances tighter).
sara: Owners: incident owner = cheng, triage lead = alex, quant lead = liam, data curation = maya.
cheng: Thanks team. Filing incident board item: https://boards.redwood/incidents/INC-2026-114
cheng: Postmortem/next steps: 1) pin recipe in production until deeper analysis, 2) run comprehensive calibration sweep, 3) add alerts for safety-suite FP spikes.
alex: I'll update the rollback PR and link CI logs.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-114 created and assigned to cheng.
cheng: Will follow up on remediation timeline tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
